what.text: This page follows refugees from Mozambique in Tanzania, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year from 1964 to 1997.
At the end of 1997, the last year in UNHCR's series for this group, it counted 33202 refugees, 98.7% of all Mozambican refugees that year.
Few refugees from Mozambique are recorded in UNHCR's data today.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over Mozambique territory between Portugal and Frelimo from 1964 to 1974.
It also records armed conflict over the government of Mozambique from 1977 to 1992, at war level in many of those years.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1964 at 10000 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 75152, at the end of 1992, and the main years of displacement in the data are 1969 to 1974 and 1987 to 1993.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they lived in Tanzania.
These are year-end totals for Tanzania only, reported to UNHCR, and the series ends in 1997.
